name: Ogori (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogori city emblem in maroon: a disc with a white stylised mountain and a notch at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Ogori, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 October 1959.

features.role: Ogori city emblem — a disc with a white stylised mountain and a notch at the top
